items.title: Vertiv Sinks 9%, GE Vernova Down 8% as Democrats Win Congress, Reviving Data Center Fears
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv fell 9% today after Democrats won Congress, dragging GE Vernova, Eaton and CoreWeave down too. Developers will still need Vertiv’s gear even if they pay more for power, so the selloff looks overdone.

items.title: Vistra Sinks 10%, Constellation Down 6% as Democrats’ “Blue Tsunami” Hits AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra stock fell 10% today after Democrats won Congress and Texas, pulling Constellation Energy, GE Vernova and Vertiv down too. Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned on a moratorium on new data centers.

items.title: SpaceX, Tesla stocks sink as analyst warns Democrats' victory will create 'major hurdles' for AI build-out
items.summary: SpaceX, Tesla, and data center-related stocks declined on Wednesday after Democrats took control of the House and Senate, raising worries of a slowdown in AI data center buildouts.

items.title: GE Vernova Soars 6%, Eaton Up 7% on Record Orders and Bernstein’s Data Center Call
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares rose 6% on Nov. 3 after Eaton’s record third-quarter orders and a bullish Bernstein note on data centers.

items.title: Eaton Just Dropped 16% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEaton stock fell 16% in the past month as AI-power stocks sold off, and GE Vernova and Vertiv fell too. The worst drop came after Meta raised its 2026 capex plans and its free cash flow turned negative.
